title: Same Character Count, Different Text Widths: 852 GOV.UK Guide Titles
source_kind: GOV.UK guide-title strings; not asserted identical to full HTML title elements
selection: fixed one-publisher frame; no population inference

exclusions.note: One excluded Welsh title had already been measured; its raw record was retained but is absent from accepted derived data.

normalization: Decode HTML entities; collapse whitespace; trim; preserve case, punctuation and Unicode form; exact string deduplication.
count_definition: Unicode codepoints; compare only exact equal codepoint counts. UTF-16 and grapheme counts are supplied separately.

measurement.primary: Canvas TextMetrics.width (advance width, not ink bounds)
measurement.raw_width_precision: whole CSS-pixel values retained without transformation

statistics: Exact codepoint groups; Type 7 interpolated percentiles; sample SD with n-1 denominator for n>1; descriptive statistics only. primary_stratum means n>=10, not statistical significance.
provenance_note: The public projection keeps source URLs, title metadata, original counts and widths, and source-screen dates; private execution paths and internal ledgers are omitted. One source-path correction is explicitly marked; no title or width changed.
source_attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
non_endorsement: No endorsement by GOV.UK or the information providers is implied.
rights_note: Source-notice screening is not exhaustive legal clearance; third-party rights and other stated exclusions remain applicable. No page bodies or font files are redistributed.
limitations: One fixed publisher frame; not a random web sample.
Historical hinting was not recorded; later reproduction checks cover 23 strings only.
Every retained width is whole pixels; no subpixel accuracy claim.
No Google rendering, rewrite, truncation, ranking or CTR observations.
Sparse length groups retained; no population confidence intervals or significance tests.
citation: Moltoyo (2026). Same Character Count, Different Text Widths: 852 GOV.UK Guide Titles. MTW-v1-2026. https://moltoyo.com/research/title-width-study
compilation_licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), only for rights held by Moltoyo in original measurements, compilation and documentation.
compilation_attribution: Attribute Moltoyo, name dataset version MTW-v1-2026, link to the study and CC BY 4.0 licence, and indicate changes. GOV.UK title strings and other third-party rights remain subject to their own source terms; Moltoyo does not relicense them.
